cast.name: 萨伯哈什·哥亥 Subhash Ghai

writer.name: 阿多尔·柯普莱克里什汗 Adoor Gopalakrishnan

director.name: 阿多尔·柯普莱克里什汗 Adoor Gopalakrishnan

introduction: Ramesh is a poorly paid employee in the city Power House. His only child has high temperature, but he mistakes it for common fever. At the Power House, employees including Ramesh demand a pay rise. When the management turns down this demand, they plot to turn off the main switch of the Power House for a few minutes in order to teach a lesson to authorities. Ramesh is entrusted with this job. In the meantime, the doctor takes the decision to immediately operate on Ramesh’s child. Ramesh is not aware of this. In the Power House, Ramesh turns off the main switch. The lights go off in the operation theatre too…
